ul.li: <topichead> creates clean, descriptive section labels in the TOC and portal navigation without implying that “Getting Started” or “Reference” is a physical topic you must author.

The same underlying topics can appear under different <topichead> groupings in other maps (for example, embedding “Troubleshooting” under a product‑specific guide), while keeping each map’s navigation user‑friendly and consistent.
